title: Cosmic Tetris
description: A cosmic twist on the classic block-stacking game with gravity shifts, special powers, and an ever-changing board.
detailedDescription: Stack falling cosmic fragments in a universe where gravity itself bends to your will. Clear lines to earn energy, unleash special abilities, and survive as the board morphs around you. Features gravity shifts every 10 lines, explosive stellar fragments, and a dynamic board that expands as you conquer new challenges.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move. Up/W to rotate. Space for hard drop. Shift for power ability.
